statement: Across the six prospectively selected Panel-2 genomes, identical primary-sample MOP identities will recur in the frozen broad boundary role above a recoverability-conditioned matched null.
support_condition: Observed above matched-null mean and one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo p<=0.05; strong support p<=0.01.
weakening_condition: Observed above null mean but p>0.05.
contamination_boundary: Panel-2 species/accessions, token universe, boundary role, statistic, null, seed and threshold frozen before Panel-2 sequence acquisition or MOP scanning.
